prompt.en: Who was the first Canadian to be awarded the Victoria Cross?
prompt.fr: Qui a été le premier Canadien à recevoir la Croix de Victoria?

explanation.en: Alexander Roberts Dunn was born in what is now Toronto. He earned the Victoria Cross at Balaclava in 1854, in the Crimean War, while serving in the British Army.
explanation.fr: Alexander Roberts Dunn est né dans ce qui est aujourd'hui Toronto. Il a mérité la Croix de Victoria à Balaklava en 1854, pendant la guerre de Crimée, alors qu'il servait dans l'armée britannique.

source.quote: served in the British Army in the Charge of the Light Brigade at Balaclava (1854) in the Crimean War, and was the first Canadian to be awarded the Victoria Cross.
